title: Scientific Industries Vortex-Genie 2
manualMd: Variable-speed touch vortexer. Two modes: continuous and touch-on. Useful for resuspending pellets, mixing reagents, and shaking small volumes.
hazardsMd:
- Don't vortex open tubes — the contents will spray. Cap or seal first.
- Avoid vortexing live cells; use gentle inversion or a low-RPM rocker.

operations.title: Daily check
operations.bodyMd: Wipe the cup head with 70% ethanol. Confirm the suction feet grip the bench.

operations.title: Resuspend a pellet
operations.bodyMd: Set to ~7 (mid-high). Touch-vortex in 5 s pulses, checking visually. Stop when no pellet remains; over-vortexing shears DNA and protein.

operations.title: Liquid sprays out
operations.bodyMd: Tube wasn't sealed. Always close cap before vortexing. If it sprayed inside the BSC, decon the area; if outside, decon and report if it was biohazardous.

operations.title: Wobbles loudly
operations.bodyMd: Cup head loose. Hand-tighten or replace. If still wobbles, the motor mount may be cracked — pull from service.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Wipe the cup head. Power off if it's a touch-on model that auto-runs.
